title: Welcome and the four nakshatra days
originalScript:
śrī gurubhyo namaḥ
ಚರಣಂ ಪವಿತ್ರಂ YouTube ಚಾನೆಲ್ನ ಪ್ರಿಯ ವೀಕ್ಷಕರಿಗೆ ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ ಸರಸ್ವತಿಯ ಪೂಜೆ ಸರಸ್ವತಿ ಪೂಜೆಯಲ್ಲಿ mūleṣu sthāpanaṁ devyāḥ
pūrvāṣāḍhāsu pūjanaṁ
uttarāṣāḍhāsu baliṁ dadyāt
śravaṇena visarjayet

structuredBlocks.english: Thus it has been stated. On Mula nakshatra day, invoke Saraswati and perform the installation. On the following Purvashadha nakshatra day, perform the worship. On Uttarashadha nakshatra day, give bali, the offering. Perform the conclusion on Shravana, on the Shravana Vijayadashami day. This is the Navaratri sequence. The coming Mula nakshatra means Monday, the 29th, for the installation and worship of Saraswati. [These are the recording’s 29 September 2025 examples, not dates prescribed for the present year.]

Two panchapatras: one for the deity and one for you. Put water in them; have the bowl and flowers and all these articles ready and sit for the worship. The first day, under Mula nakshatra, is invocation only. Sit facing north, north-facing; otherwise sit facing east and perform achamana.

title: Sankalpa
originalScript:
ಎಡಗೈಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಮಂತ್ರಾಕ್ಷತೆಯನ್ನ ಹಾಕಿಕೊಂಡು ಎಡಗೈ ಮೇಲೆ ಬಲಗೈಯನ್ನ ಇಟ್ಟುಕೊಂಡು ಬಲದ ತೊಡೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಇಟ್ಟುಕೊಳ್ಳಿ śubhe śobhane muhūrte ādya brahmaṇaḥ dvitīya parārdhe śrī śvetavarāha kalpe vaivasvata manvantare aṣṭāviṁśatitame kaliyuge prathamapāde
bhāratavarṣe bharatakhaṇḍe daṇḍakāraṇye godāvaryāḥ dakṣiṇe tīre śālivāhana śake bhautāvatāre rāmakṣetre
asmin vartamāne prabhavādi ṣaṣṭi saṁvatsarāṇāṁ madhye śubhe viśvāvasu nāma saṁvatsare dakṣiṇāyane śaradṛtau āśvījamāse śuklapakṣe saptamyāṁ
vāsara vāsarastu induvāsarayuktāyāṁ mūlanakṣatrayuktāyāṁ śubhanakṣatra śubhayoga śubhakaraṇa evaṁguṇa sakalaviśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭāyāṁ śubhatithau
bhāratīramaṇa mukhyaprāṇa antargata śrī vedavyāsa preraṇayā śrī vedavyāsa prītyarthaṁ pustakeṣu sannihita sarasvatyātmaka śrī vyāsa paraśurāma āvāhana pūjāṁ pratiṣṭhāpana pūjāṁ kariṣye

title: Kapila and Dattatreya
originalScript:

Offer betel leaves, areca nut and coconut as naivedya [the short connective around “coconut” is unclear]. Having offered naivedya, perform mangalarati and finish. Perform mangalarati in the hand [the two acoustic passes retain this instruction’s wording; it is not expanded into an unrecorded motion]. After doing that, hold mantrakshata in the right hand and pour two uddharanis of water into it.

action: Offer flowers and akshata, recite known suktas or a deity stotra, offer pushpanjali and naivedya, perform the recorded arati and hold akshata in the right hand with two spoonfuls of water.
